narrative.northStar: The Modern Flatline Campus Commerce Ledger
narrative.overview: Project Kita combines the high-efficiency, line-ruled precision of Amazon and Nike digital storefronts with the warm, collegiate brand identity of Luis Y. Ferrer Jr. Senior High School (LYFJSHS). It rejects bloated, bubble-card container sprawl and floating drop-shadow layers in favor of a crisp, flatline structural grid bounded by hairline 1px dividers, high-contrast typography, and an asymmetrical 2-column architecture.
keyCharacteristics: Flatline Line-Ruled Structure: Crisp 1px hairline dividers (#EFE4E2) delineate content zones without redundant nested cards.
Asymmetrical 2-Column Topology: Sticky left rails for contextual navigation, quick filters, and status summaries alongside wide, uninterrupted right data streams.
Left-Anchored Alignment: Content anchors directly to the workspace without artificial mx-auto gutters.
Collegiate Crimson Red & Warm Paper: Retains #D92323 primary accent, #FAF6F5 warm paper base, #1F1315 espresso ink, and #F59E0B amber spark.

rules.name: The Flatline Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation of sections, listings, and data cells is achieved via 1px #EFE4E2 ruled lines, never through floating card dropshadows.

rules.name: The Zero-Centering Rule
rules.body: Layouts anchor from the left edge; mx-auto centering blobs are strictly avoided on dashboard workspaces.

dos: Do use ruled 1px hairline lines (border-line / #EFE4E2) to structure sections and grids.
Do anchor layouts as asymmetrical 2-column streams (Left rail + Right stream).
Do maintain the Collegiate Crimson Red (#D92323) and Espresso Ink (#1F1315) palette.
Do keep product prices and numbers in Space Mono with tabular numerals.
donts: Don't nest cards inside cards inside cards.
Don't use floating heavy box shadows on resting elements.
Don't use mx-auto to center dashboards into narrow floating islands.
Don't change the branding or color tokens.
